name: R392-C1 typed stock-provenance content notation
boundary: A complete symbolic representation of the frozen29content positions, not a historical script, executable laboratory protocol or target writer. No source clause equals one written word by definition.

A: The author asserts/predicts Formula; not certified physical truth.
D: The reader is instructed to make Formula hold.
G: Announced goal, not an extra observed operation.
DECLARE: Bind a typed discourse handle; existential identity except explicit equality/UNRESOLVED_ID. Not automatically a fresh physical object.
BECAUSE: Keep an explanation or reason together with what it explains.
PURPOSE: Keep the stated purpose; does not assert it was achieved.
ALTERNATIVE: Written alternative branches; neither silently selected.
FORALL: Quantify over the explicitly bounded set.
SET: Ordered written listing with set denotation; no duplicates used here.
CHOICE: Two explicitly stated alternatives, same sort.
UP: Collected rising fraction stock generated by that distillation event.
LOW: Retained bottom fraction stock of that distillation event.
MIX: Combined stock produced by COMBINE event.
OR: Logical/distributive alternative within a quantified formula; distinguished from outer ALTERNATIVE of statements.
ALLOC: Explicit use-site aliquot binding, not an extra source operation. Selects a positive amount <= available stock; never silently the entire stock.

fixed_predicate_lexicon.OMIT_FOR: Agent Reason Formula | omit the indicated act for this reason
fixed_predicate_lexicon.REVEAL: Agent Agent Content | disclose a specified content
fixed_predicate_lexicon.EXTRACT: Kind Domain | extract that element from the stated prior-material domain
fixed_predicate_lexicon.THEN: Formula Formula | prescribe their temporal order
fixed_predicate_lexicon.AFTER: Formula EventOrFormula | prescribe the first after completion of the second
fixed_predicate_lexicon.REDUCE_TO: MaterialRef Kind | requested reduction of a kind in a goal or explicit aliquot in the final prerequisite
fixed_predicate_lexicon.PREVIOUSLY_DESCRIBED: Formula Procedure | explicit external reference, with no invented expansion
fixed_predicate_lexicon.EXAMPLE: Kind Stock | exemplary choice, not forced exclusive identity
fixed_predicate_lexicon.KIND: Entity Kind | classification with source role preserved
fixed_predicate_lexicon.MOVE: Aliquot Location | transport the selected aliquot; does not move every aliquot from its parent stock
fixed_predicate_lexicon.ROLE: Entity Role | stated functional role, not physical identity
fixed_predicate_lexicon.NEST: Vessel Vessel | put first vessel inside second; distinct types from contents
fixed_predicate_lexicon.DISTIL: Event Aliquot Vessel Heat Path | distillation occasion creates UP/LOW provenance stocks; no mass equality or chemical efficacy is inferred
fixed_predicate_lexicon.DISTILS: Event Kind | onset of that distillate
fixed_predicate_lexicon.RECEIVE: Stock Vessel | collection destination, no stipulated recovered amount
fixed_predicate_lexicon.NO_MORE_RISE: Event Heat | no further ascent at the specified heat regime
fixed_predicate_lexicon.ONLY_COMPONENT: Stock Kind | source claims the indicated element alone, not a modern assay
fixed_predicate_lexicon.COMPONENTS: Stock Set | source-named component kinds; not measured proportions
fixed_predicate_lexicon.CANNOT_RAISE: Heat Kind | historical negative capacity assertion
fixed_predicate_lexicon.COMBINE: Event Aliquot Aliquot Vessel Relation | combine these selected aliquots, first over second; produces MIX stock
fixed_predicate_lexicon.RETURN: Vessel Location | return a vessel to a former position; material-class return is separately RETURN_KIND
fixed_predicate_lexicon.HOLD: Event Stock BathVessel Quantity | hold stock in its process container in this external bath; does not put process material into bath water
fixed_predicate_lexicon.SEAL: Vessel Formula | close the container with a stated purpose/constraint
fixed_predicate_lexicon.DISTILL_ANY: Vessel | any distillation from the indicated vessel
fixed_predicate_lexicon.APPEARANCE: Stock Set | qualities/names of appearance, distinguished from component analysis
fixed_predicate_lexicon.SEPARATE: Kind Kind | purpose of obtaining distinct fractions
fixed_predicate_lexicon.SET_ASIDE: Stock | keep the indicated product separate; amount not quantified
fixed_predicate_lexicon.IDENTIFIED_AS: Stock Kind | source equates this stock/product with the named element
fixed_predicate_lexicon.STILL_AVAILABLE: Stock | retained source stock remains, with positive amount not quantified
fixed_predicate_lexicon.UNRESOLVED_ID: Stock Set | one of the listed available sources or explicit external source; no chosen member
fixed_predicate_lexicon.DOSE: Aliquot Quantity Aliquot Quantity | written four-pounds-over-one prescription; interpretation policy below
fixed_predicate_lexicon.SAME_METHOD: Event Event | shared method, does not equate vessels or materials
fixed_predicate_lexicon.COLLECT_WHILE: Stock Formula | collect while the written condition holds
fixed_predicate_lexicon.WRITTEN_NAME: Stock Kind | preserve the actual source name, including conflicting names; not automatic compositional truth
fixed_predicate_lexicon.OBTAINED_APART: Set | declared set of separated endpoint products
fixed_predicate_lexicon.RETURN_KIND: Kind | generic reintroduction of this material class, not a specific stock reference
fixed_predicate_lexicon.EXTRACT_FROM: Set Kind | named extraction of kinds from another
fixed_predicate_lexicon.NEEDS_FOR: Kind Process Kind | historical prerequisite for the stated process
fixed_predicate_lexicon.CALL: Procedure Aliquot Apparatus Kind | apply fixed external procedure to this aliquot; body and internal result-stock bindings remain unexpanded
fixed_predicate_lexicon.RECTIFY: Aliquot Formula | rectify selected amount by stated operation
fixed_predicate_lexicon.ASCEND: Aliquot Apparatus | make selected amount ascend through apparatus; internal fraction bindings not specified
fixed_predicate_lexicon.BEFORE: Formula Formula | prerequisite even when stated later in textual order
fixed_predicate_lexicon.CALCINE: Aliquot Quantity Apparatus | calcination for stated duration and furnace
fixed_predicate_lexicon.UNRESOLVED_REASON: Reason | deictic reason here, antecedent not resolved
fixed_predicate_lexicon.HEARD: Agent Content | content heard by reader
fixed_predicate_lexicon.TAUGHT: Agent Agent Content | author communicated that content to reader
fixed_predicate_lexicon.SAME_STOCK: Stock Stock | provenance identity, stronger than KIND equality; may be negated
fixed_predicate_lexicon.MEMBERS: SetHandle Set | bind finite set of like-typed references
fixed_predicate_lexicon.ONSET_CONDITION: Event Formula | condition for initial heating to enter the productive phase, not the termination of the entire distillation
fixed_predicate_lexicon.IS_REASON: Reason | refer to the explicitly bound but unresolved reason

complete_program_blocks.symbolic_text:
(A (WILL author (NOT (OMIT_FOR author small_reason (REVEAL author reader chapter_secret)))))
(G (FORALL x ELEMENTS (THEN (EXTRACT x prior_materials) (SHOW_APART x))))
(G (FORALL x ELEMENTS (AFTER (REDUCE_TO x quintessence) (SHOW_APART x))))

(DECLARE P0 stock (AND (SELECTED_FROM P0 prior_materials) (QUAL P0 putrefied) (QUAL P0 liquefied)))
(A (PREVIOUSLY_DESCRIBED (PREPARE P0) previous_preparation))
(A (EXAMPLE human_blood P0))
(ALLOC A0 P0 unquantified)

(DECLARE V0 vessel (AND (KIND V0 distillatory) (QUAL V0 glass)))
(D (MOVE A0 (IN V0)))

(DECLARE V1 vessel (KIND V1 pot))
(DECLARE P1 stock (AND (KIND P1 water) (ROLE P1 heating_medium)))
(A (AT P1 (IN V1)))
(D (NEST V0 V1))

(DECLARE V2 vessel (AND (KIND V2 amphora) (QUAL V2 glass) (QUAL V2 very_clean)))
(DECLARE V3 apparatus (KIND V3 alembic_tube))
(D (DISTIL E0 A0 V0 bath V3))
(D (APPLY_HEAT E0 below))
(D (ONSET_CONDITION E0 (DISTILS E0 water)))
(D (RECEIVE (UP E0) V2))

(D (UNTIL E0 (NO_MORE_RISE E0 bath)))
(A (AT_STOP E0 (ONLY_COMPONENT (UP E0) water)))

(BECAUSE
  (A (COMPONENTS (LOW E0) (SET air fire earth)))
  (AND (CANNOT_RAISE bath air) (CANNOT_RAISE bath fire) (CANNOT_RAISE bath earth)))
(A (REMAINS (LOW E0) (BOTTOM V0)))

(ALLOC A1 (UP E0) unquantified)
(ALLOC A2 (LOW E0) unquantified)
(D (COMBINE E1 A1 A2 V0 over))

(D (RETURN V0 (IN V1)))
(D (HOLD E2 (MIX E1) V1 (Q 7 day)))
(D (MIX_WELL (MIX E1)))
(D (SEAL V0 (DURING E2 (NOT (DISTILL_ANY V0)))))

(ALLOC A3 (MIX E1) unquantified)
(D (AFTER (DISTIL E3 A3 V0 ash unstated_path) E2))
(A (STRONGER ash bath))
(A (APPEARANCE (UP E3) (SET water oil bright golden)))

(DECLARE V4 vessel (KIND V4 ampulla))
(D (UNTIL E3 (NO_MORE_RISE E3 ash)))
(A (AT_STOP E3 (AND (AT (UP E3) (IN V4)) (COMPONENTS (UP E3) (SET water air)))))

(DECLARE V5 vessel (ROLE V5 processing_container))
(ALLOC A4 (UP E3) unquantified)
(PURPOSE
  (D (DISTIL E4 A4 V5 bath unstated_path))
  (SEPARATE water air))
(A (AND (ONLY_COMPONENT (UP E4) water) (QUAL (UP E4) clear)))
(A (AND (ONLY_COMPONENT (LOW E4) air) (APPEARANCE (LOW E4) (SET oil golden)) (REMAINS (LOW E4) (BOTTOM V5))))

(D (SET_ASIDE (LOW E4)))
(A (IDENTIFIED_AS (LOW E4) air))
(A (AND (STILL_AVAILABLE (LOW E3)) (COMPONENTS (LOW E3) (SET fire earth))))

(DECLARE P2 stock (AND (KIND P2 water) (QUAL P2 elemental) (UNRESOLVED_ID P2 (SET (UP E0) (UP E4) external_water))))
(ALLOC A5 P2 unquantified)
(ALLOC A6 (LOW E3) unquantified)
(PURPOSE
  (D (COMBINE E5 A5 A6 V0 over))
  (SEPARATE fire earth))
(D (DOSE A5 (Q 4 pound) A6 (Q 1 pound)))

(DECLARE V6 vessel (ROLE V6 water_bath))
(PURPOSE
  (D (HOLD E6 (MIX E5) V6 (CHOICE (Q 7 day) (Q 8 day))))
  (QUAL (MIX E5) well_incorporated))
(A (SAME_METHOD E6 E2))

(ALLOC A7 (MIX E5) unquantified)
(D (AFTER (DISTIL E7 A7 V0 strong_flame unstated_path) E6))

(A (APPEARANCE (UP E7) (SET water red)))
(D (COLLECT_WHILE (UP E7) (ANY_RISE E7)))

(A (AND (REMAINS (LOW E7) (BOTTOM V0)) (WRITTEN_NAME (LOW E7) water) (QUAL (LOW E7) very_black)))
(D (SET_ASIDE (LOW E7)))

(ALLOC A8 (UP E7) unquantified)
(A (AND (QUAL (UP E7) very_red) (COMPONENTS (UP E7) (SET water fire))))

(DECLARE V7 vessel (KIND V7 distillatory))
(D (DISTIL E8 A8 V7 bath unstated_path))
(A (AND (ONLY_COMPONENT (UP E8) water) (QUAL (UP E8) clear)))
(A (AND (REMAINS (LOW E8) (BOTTOM V7)) (APPEARANCE (LOW E8) (SET oil red)) (IDENTIFIED_AS (LOW E8) fire)))

(DECLARE P3 stock (AND (KIND P3 water) (QUAL P3 elemental) (UNRESOLVED_ID P3 (SET (UP E0) (UP E4) (UP E8) P2))))
(A (OBTAINED_APART (SET (LOW E4) P3 (LOW E8) (LOW E7))))
(A (AND (IDENTIFIED_AS (LOW E4) air) (IDENTIFIED_AS P3 water) (IDENTIFIED_AS (LOW E8) fire) (IDENTIFIED_AS (LOW E7) earth)))

(BECAUSE
  (A (PURPOSE_OF (RETURN_KIND water) (EXTRACT_FROM (SET air fire) earth)))
  (FORALL x (SET air fire) (NEEDS_FOR x ascent water)))

(ALLOC A9 (LOW E4) unquantified)
(ALLOC A10 P3 unquantified)
(ALLOC A11 (LOW E8) unquantified)
(ALLOC A12 (LOW E7) unquantified)
(DECLARE S0 aliquot_set (MEMBERS S0 (SET A9 A10 A11 A12)))
(ALTERNATIVE
  (D (FORALL x S0 (CALL previous_circulation x circulation_vessel quintessence)))
  (D (FOR_ONE x S0 (RECTIFY x (REPEAT 7 (ASCEND x aludel))))))

(D (BEFORE
  (CALCINE A12 (Q 21 day) (CHOICE glassmakers_furnace reverberatory_furnace))
  (REDUCE_TO A12 quintessence)))
(A (AND (WRITTEN_NAME (LOW E7) earth) (QUAL (LOW E7) very_black)))

(DECLARE R0 reason (UNRESOLVED_REASON R0))
(BECAUSE
  (A (WILL author (NOT (SPEAK_FURTHER author science))))
  (IS_REASON R0))
(BECAUSE
  (D (PRAISE reader God))
  (AND (HEARD reader chapter_content) (TAUGHT author reader chapter_content)))

semantic_policies: An output selector denotes a generated stock/provenance source, not one indivisible mass token. ALLOC binds a use-site aliquot. Its amount is positive and unspecified unless constrained by DOSE; never assume it equals the whole stock. ALLOC is a semantic argument binding, not a newly asserted historical manipulation.

Repeated aliquot handle denotes the same allocated amount across MOVE and DISTIL. Repeated stock handle denotes the same available source, not necessarily the same aliquot. No stock is silently consumed in full.

Total withdrawals from a stock must not exceed its available amount in any concrete realization. Amounts and unwithdrawn remainders are not supplied by the source. Outputs may suffer losses; no total-mass equality is added.
UP/LOW output stocks have event provenance and distinct fraction roles. MIX is generated only by COMBINE. This does not certify the historical element chemistry.

All uppercase reference IDs are local editorial handles, canonically numbered in first-introduction order within sort. DECLARE creates a discourse reference, not a fresh physical vessel unless explicitly stated. Only first-return V0/V1 identity is fixed by the selected interpretation; other apparatus handles may alias consistent with what is written.

P2 water identity remains the finite unresolved choice UP(E0),UP(E4),external_water; previous stocks qualify only if a sufficient amount is still available. The pool is chosen before the later operation; no automatic choice is made.
P3 denotes water in the endpoint assertion; its identity among earlier named available water stocks is unresolved, and this representation does not silently combine them.

DOSE preserves both written quantities4pounds and1pound. C1 interprets them as a proportional prescription for the two allocated inputs. Literal-batch interpretation is a declared rival, not silently interchangeable; absolute amounts remain unknown under proportional reading.

1561 water/earth naming conflict is recorded by WRITTEN_NAME of LOW(E7) at two positions, with the endpoint earth assertion retained. Names are not silently repaired. This content representation may preserve inconsistent source assertions without validating them as physical facts.

The printed vel/vnum clause is represented by one explicit scope: either reduce each by circulation or choose one for sevenfold rectification. Distributive each(either method) remains a distinct explicitly recorded scope rival; no claim of resolved Latin scope.
Procedures previous_preparation and previous_circulation remain typed external calls; their implementations are not invented. Apparatus paths unstated in the paragraph remain unstated_path.
The introductory pro modico is provisionally represented as small_reason modifying omission. This rhetorical interpretation is not a diplomatic fact. Closing R0 remains an unresolved deictic reason.
No statement kind accepts arbitrary prose text or a source-clause ID as its meaning. All heads and constants are the fixed finite tables in this file.

A9..A12 are explicit possible endpoint input allocations, not amounts withdrawn or consumed before an alternative is chosen. CALCINE and earth reduction share A12. CALL/RECTIFY bodies and their internal generated stocks remain unexpanded, so no certified global serial creation count follows.

rivals.name: Independent external same-type water at first return
rivals.same_grammar_text:
(DECLARE P4 stock (AND (KIND P4 water) (QUAL P4 elemental) (UNRESOLVED_ID P4 (SET external_water)) (NOT (SAME_STOCK P4 (UP E0)))))
(ALLOC A1 P4 unquantified)
rivals.replaces: The A1 ALLOC at inventory09; all other source blocks fixed.
rivals.difference: Return input no longer derives from first collected output. Same component class and later instructions do not repair that written provenance loss.

rivals.name: Different-stock same-type residue
rivals.same_grammar_text:
(DECLARE P5 stock (AND (COMPONENTS P5 (SET air fire earth)) (NOT (SAME_STOCK P5 (LOW E0)))))
(ALLOC A2 P5 unquantified)
rivals.replaces: The A2 ALLOC at09; all other source blocks fixed.
rivals.difference: Return is no longer over the earlier retained three-element stock.

rivals.name: Different positive return amounts from the correct source stock
rivals.replaces: Nothing: this is exactly the original written aliquot binding.
rivals.difference: Two concrete realizations may choose distinct positive amounts <=available stock. The source and C1 do not distinguish them. This is not presented as a rejected rival or a different required string.

rivals.name: Choose known recovered water for the later dose
rivals.difference: An optional in-grammar completion only if enough stock remains. Source does not select it; external_water remains possible.

rivals.name: Distributive method alternative
rivals.same_grammar_text: (D (FORALL x S0 (OR (CALL previous_circulation x circulation_vessel quintessence) (RECTIFY x (REPEAT 7 (ASCEND x aludel))))))
rivals.difference: Each selected elemental product may use either method, unlike outer all-circulation versus one-rectification. A real scope difference in the same grammar, currently unresolved by source collation.

writing_realization: The fully written S-expressions are a modern symbolic content notation with fixed heads, literal constant labels and explicit references. They are not a Voynich script-realization contract. No letter code, word packing, spacing, contextual allomorphs or relative-reference representation is selected.
checks: Static documentary checks only: balanced parentheses, defined heads, all29inventory positions mapped. No semantic runner/decoder/control corpus.

binding_ledger.definition: (DECLARE P0 stock (AND (SELECTED_FROM P0 prior_materials) (QUAL P0 putrefied) (QUAL P0 liquefied)))
(DECLARE V0 vessel (AND (KIND V0 distillatory) (QUAL V0 glass)))
(DECLARE P1 stock (AND (KIND P1 water) (ROLE P1 heating_medium)))
(DECLARE V2 vessel (AND (KIND V2 amphora) (QUAL V2 glass) (QUAL V2 very_clean)))
(D (AFTER (DISTIL E3 A3 V0 ash unstated_path) E2))
(DECLARE P2 stock (AND (KIND P2 water) (QUAL P2 elemental) (UNRESOLVED_ID P2 (SET (UP E0) (UP E4) external_water))))
(D (AFTER (DISTIL E7 A7 V0 strong_flame unstated_path) E6))
(DECLARE P3 stock (AND (KIND P3 water) (QUAL P3 elemental) (UNRESOLVED_ID P3 (SET (UP E0) (UP E4) (UP E8) P2))))
(DECLARE S0 aliquot_set (MEMBERS S0 (SET A9 A10 A11 A12)))

binding_policy: Ledger order follows first textual introduction, not physical creation of vessels. Outputs are recorded immediately after their producing event, UP before LOW by editorial convention. That within-event order is NOT historical evidence. ALLOC bindings count explicitly. P2/P3/V aliases do not prove creation of new physical stock/vessels. Bound x is separately scoped per FORALL/FOR_ONE, enumerated over existing sets and creates no stock.

lexical_constants_explained.ampulla: later receiver name; not automatically same object as amphora
lexical_constants_explained.apparatus: declaration sort, not a material meaning
lexical_constants_explained.author: source first-person speaker
lexical_constants_explained.bath: water-bath heat regime, not process-water stock
lexical_constants_explained.circulation_vessel: apparatus used by prior circulation procedure
lexical_constants_explained.external_water: origin alternative for P2, not an unlisted physical stock ID
lexical_constants_explained.fire: source element fire, distinct from heat regime
lexical_constants_explained.human_blood: explicit example kind, not a required identity for every possible initial material
lexical_constants_explained.oil: appearance term; not automatically a fifth element
lexical_constants_explained.over: placement relation of added liquid to retained material
lexical_constants_explained.previous_circulation: fixed external procedure reference, no free procedure body
lexical_constants_explained.prior_materials: bounded only by earlier source domain; not newly enumerated substances
lexical_constants_explained.processing_container: existential container role where exact glass-vessel identity is unstated
lexical_constants_explained.reason: declaration sort for the unresolved concluding cause
lexical_constants_explained.small_reason: provisional semantic reading of pro modico; scope/translation debt retained
lexical_constants_explained.strong_flame: flame heat with written strong qualification, fixed whole lexical constant in this version
lexical_constants_explained.unquantified: explicit unspecified positive amount, not zero or whole-stock default
lexical_constants_explained.unstated_path: no conduit stated at this later source position; cannot denote arbitrary missing clause
lexical_constants_explained.vessel: container declaration sort, distinct from contents
lexical_constants_explained.water: water kind reused across relevant roles; not a unique physical stock
